package.name: dual_arm_workspace_analysis
package.description: C4.1: dual-arm workspace and manipulability analysis. Samples the 12-DOF configuration space with a Halton low-discrepancy sequence, filters self-colliding configurations through the C2.7 capsule distance model, and records, per accepted sample: TCP positions, the relative pose/rotation, arm and relative manipulability, the minimum singular value of J_rel and its numerical rank. Pure C++/Eigen (no ROS runtime); the CSVs/binaries feed the Python plotting pipeline and C4.2.
